# Senai Technology

> AI-built websites with a pulse. Creative technology studio between New York and Addis Ababa.

## About

Senai Technology is a creative technology studio between New York and Addis Ababa. We design and build premium, animated, AI-accelerated websites, plus mobile apps, brand identity, motion and AI tools for businesses. We are a Slotted LLC company founded by Senai Motley.

## Website Tiers

We offer three tiers for AI-built websites:

### Launch
**One sharp page, live fast.**
Best for: New businesses, launches, events

Includes:
- A single long-scroll page with tasteful motion
- Mobile-first, responsive build
- Contact or booking form
- Search + social previews set up
- Domain and hosting setup

### Studio
**A multi-page site with a real identity.**
Best for: Growing brands, shops, practices

Includes:
- Everything in Launch
- Multiple pages, shaped around your content
- Type, colour and art direction for the web
- Art-directed AI imagery
- Analytics and a simple way to update content

### Signature (Flagship)
**A fully animated showcase, built to be remembered.**
Best for: Brands that want the wow

Includes:
- Everything in Studio
- Custom 3D / WebGL hero like the one on our site
- Scroll-driven storytelling and micro-interactions
- Motion assets and AI-generated visuals
- Performance tuning for real phones

## Process

### 01. Brief
A short call about the business, the audience and the feeling the site should leave behind.

### 02. Direction
Type, colour and a motion concept, delivered as a clickable prototype you can react to early.

### 03. Build
AI-accelerated build, hand-tuned details: motion, responsiveness, performance, accessibility.

### 04. Launch
Domain, analytics and a walkthrough. Then we keep iterating together if you want to.

## What's Included

All tiers include:
- **Designed in motion**: You click through a moving prototype early, not a static mockup
- **Mobile-first**: Built for thumbs first, then scaled up. Just as smooth on a phone
- **Fast by default**: Lean code, lazy-loaded media and effects that pause off-screen
- **Accessible**: Semantic HTML, keyboard support and reduced-motion fallbacks
- **Easy to find**: Titles, descriptions and social cards set up for search and sharing
- **Clean handover**: A walkthrough at launch so you know how everything fits together

## Portfolio

### Senai Technology (Live - 2026)
**Studio website · WebGL, React**
The site you're on. A raymarched liquid form rendered through an ordered dither, with a lens that reveals the real render underneath. Built AI-accelerated, tuned by hand, and it respects reduced-motion settings.

### OpenSlot (Shipped)
**Mobile app · iOS**
An event and performance app for iPhone. Venues host open mics and DJ nights in minutes; performers discover comedy, music, poetry and DJ slots nearby and reserve with one tap. Designed and built by Senai Motley; on the App Store.
Link: https://openslot.me

### Concept Projects
We showcase placeholder concepts demonstrating our capabilities:
- Local service websites with instant quote requests
- Café & bakery sites with pre-orders and daily menus
- AI booking assistants for appointment scheduling

Beyond websites, we also offer:

### Mobile apps
iOS and Android, from first prototype to App Store release. We've shipped our own.

### AI tools for businesses
Chatbots, booking assistants and quiet automations that give your team hours back.

### Interactive & event experiences
Installations, live visuals and web toys for launches, venues and performances.
